dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: The dorsal-lateral region exhibits multiple 'O' and 'C' shaped structures with irregular, crenulated perimeters. These structures show a high-contrast transition from the dark base-coat pixels to a light grey-white boundary approximately 2-5 pixels wide. The edge geometry is characterized by high-frequency jaggedness rather than smooth curves.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High spatial density of small, irregular light-intensity pixel clusters is concentrated in the anterior (left-most) visible region. The mid-body dorsal section transitions to a lower density, dominated by larger, discrete macro-annuli with lower core pixel concentration.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three largest mid-dorsal annuli form an obtuse scalene triangle. A secondary linear arrangement of four centroids from smaller high-intensity blobs runs parallel to the upper-dorsal curve in the anterior quadrant.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A prominent, localized cluster of high-intensity red and magenta pixels is visible on the far left margin, representing a distinct chromatic anomaly compared to the monochromatic texture elsewhere, indicative of a physical lesion or trauma.
other_distinctive_markers: A complex, interlocking 'honeycomb' topology is present where multiple annuli share common boundary segments, particularly visible in the lower-anterior lateral region.
